title: Composed supervisory control: Good/reject batch statistics with reject lockout -> Edge-counted batch with consecutive-reject lockout

inputs.name: A_BatchTarget
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Total parts in a batch

inputs.name: B_Rejected
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Current item rejection flag

inputs.name: B_RejectLimit
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Consecutive rejects causing lockout

outputs.name: A_QualityFault
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Reject count exceeded limit

outputs.name: B_ConsecutiveRejects
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Current consecutive reject count

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: BatchTarget and RejectLimit remain positive and constant during a test.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A good-part rising edge increments only A_GoodCount; a reject-part rising edge increments only A_RejectCount.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous good and reject edges shall count one reject and no good part.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_GoodPart) AND rose(A_RejectPart) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_RejectCount=prev(A_RejectCount)+1 AND A_GoodCount=prev(A_GoodCount)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_BatchDone shall be TRUE when A_GoodCount plus A_RejectCount reaches A_BatchTarget.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_QualityFault shall latch when A_RejectCount reaches A_RejectLimit and remain set until A_Reset.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear both counts, A_BatchDone, and A_QualityFault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Only a rising B_ItemPulse while not stopped, B_Complete, or locked shall count one item.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: An accepted item increments B_AcceptedCount and clears B_ConsecutiveRejects; a B_Rejected item increments both reject counters.
requirements.property: G(accepted_edge -> (B_AcceptedCount=prev(B_AcceptedCount)+1 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0)) AND G(rejected_edge -> (B_RejectCount=prev(B_RejectCount)+1 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=prev(B_ConsecutiveRejects)+1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Complete shall latch when B_AcceptedCount reaches positive B_Target and no later item may change counts.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_RejectLimit less than or equal to zero, or reaching B_RejectLimit consecutive rejects, shall latch B_LockedOut.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop has priority over B_ItemPulse and prevents every count change.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears all state only while B_Stop is TRUE and B_ItemPulse is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((B_Reset AND B_Stop AND !B_ItemPulse)->(B_AcceptedCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0 AND !B_Complete AND !B_LockedOut))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_BatchDone shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
